title: Vxiyan's Vanilla+
description: Overhauling many vanilla features and Adds new things that enhances the game.
body:
# **Vxiyan's Vanilla+**
### **Features**
- This modpack adds Features such as Simply Swords to add more weapon choices and magical abilities, also adding Vanilla Tweaks for a day counter and other features.
- This modpack also includes texture packs that make your enchanted weapons have a cool outline.
- Finally, more biomes and structures were added for more content.
- **Modpack is buggy, things are still being worked on and being fixed.**
### Goal
This modpack's goal is to enhance the vanilla game by adding new features and texture packs to improve the quality of life features in the game.
